item.title: Tree branches hanging over my park home, 30th July
item.description:
I live at 125 harthurstfield Park fiddlers green lane my back door side of garden has a huge London plain tree in the big house next door. The tree when full of leaves blocks out the light in my kitchen and large branches are hanging over my home. There has been several deadwood branches come down over my 5 years of being here, 2 of which were at least 6ft long missed my husband by inches. Who do we sue if either my husband, myself or my young grandchildren are hit by a branch
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 102, Fiddlers Green Lane, Hatherley, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet
